definition: Teneo.ai, formerly known as Artificial Solutions, is a multinational technology company that develops technology for conversational AI systems.
details: The company's products have been deployed in several industries including automotive, finance, energy, entertainment, telecoms, the public sector, retail and travel. Its customers include telecom providers such as AT&T, as well as other organisations such as Medtronic, Circle K and Folksam, The company was founded in 2001 and became a public company in 2019 after conducting a reverse takeover of Indentive AB. In August 2024, Artificial Solutions rebranded to Teneo.ai. Teneo.ai is listed on the Nasdaq First North stock exchange under the ticker symbol TENEO. The symbol was previously ASAI for Artificial Solutions.

explainer.lead: Teneo.ai, formerly Artificial Solutions, is a multinational company that builds technology for conversational AI systems. It matters because its products run customer-facing assistants in regulated and high-volume industries.

tiers.eli5: It is a company that makes the software behind chatbots and voice assistants, so a bank or phone company can answer customers automatically.
tiers.practitioner: Teams adopt Teneo.ai when they need a vendor platform for conversational deployments rather than building from scratch. The pitfall is vendor lock-in: conversation logic lives on the platform, so migrating it later carries cost.
tiers.paperLevel: A commercial conversational AI technology provider, founded 2001, public since 2019 via a reverse takeover of Indentive AB, rebranded from Artificial Solutions in August 2024. No formal algorithmic definition applies; limits are those of the deployed system.

explainer.example: A telecom provider deploys a Teneo.ai-built assistant to handle customer conversations, drawing on the platform's conversational AI technology.
